projects.title: Bringing a Korean activewear brand to the U.S.

projects.title: Scaling a creator program to 400 creators a month
projects.summary: Ran the full creator funnel, from gifting to affiliate and paid usage. I segmented creators by category and audience fit to find the most responsive groups, tracked drop-off by product, and sent weekly recommendations to leadership.

results.label: Higher acceptance rate than agency-run campaigns

projects.title: Growing a startup accelerator's LinkedIn
projects.summary: Planned and published event promotion and program content for a Korean government startup accelerator, and ran onboarding communications for its member companies.

projects.title: Filling the room for campus cultural events

about.heading: About me
about.body:
I study how people think, and I use it to market to them honestly. My background in cognitive science and user experience shapes how I approach marketing: start with the audience, find the one benefit that matters to them, and say it clearly.

I'm a native speaker of both Korean and English, and I love work that sits between cultures, whether that's bringing a Korean brand to the U.S. or connecting international students on campus. Outside of work, I front a Korean-American band called Seoul Juice.
